invariants.description: O2 content matches the exact washout solution for the logged (time-varying) flow: C = C_in + (C_init - C_in) exp(-int v dt / q_0)
CO2 content matches the exact first-order washout solution
Spencer inverse is exact: forward curve at (P_O2_out, P_CO2_out) returns C_O2_out (below 99% of saturation, where the inversion is well conditioned)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.where((C_O2_out_extra_ub == 0) & (C_O2_out < 0.99*C_O2_sat), np.abs(C_O2_sat*((P_O2_out)*(1 + beta_1*(P_CO2_out))/(k_1*(1 + alpha_1*(P_CO2_out))))**(1/h_1)/(1 + ((P_O2_out)*(1 + beta_1*(P_CO2_out))/(k_1*(1 + alpha_1*(P_CO2_out))))**(1/h_1)) - C_O2_out), 0)) <= 1e-6*C_O2_sat

np.max(np.where((C_O2_out_extra_ub == 0) & (C_O2_out < 0.99*C_O2_sat) & (C_CO2_out < 0.99*C_CO2_sat), np.abs(C_CO2_sat*((P_CO2_out)*(1 + beta_2*(P_O2_out))/(k_2*(1 + alpha_2*(P_O2_out))))**(1/h_2)/(1 + ((P_CO2_out)*(1 + beta_2*(P_O2_out))/(k_2*(1 + alpha_2*(P_O2_out))))**(1/h_2)) - C_CO2_out), 0)) <= 1e-6*C_CO2_sat

bc_sweep.rationale: Contents from severely hypoxaemic venous blood (0.02 ml/ml, S ~ 10%) to fully saturated arterial blood (0.21 > C_O2_sat = 0.2045, which exercises the over-cap branch), CO2 0.40-0.60 ml/ml; compartment volumes 50 ml - 2 L.

baseline.reason: candidate: the O2 dissociation curve implied by the P_O2_out(C_O2_out) inverse vs the standard human curve (Severinghaus 1979 eq. 1, which fits the standard curve to +-0.0055 saturation; points in instances/default/severinghaus1979_odc.csv). Offline, Spencer/C_sat at P_CO2 = 40 mmHg is within 0.03 saturation of it (max near P_O2 = 20-30 mmHg). Needs a curve (x-y) baseline mode rather than a time series.
